description: A machine computes output \(y\) at input \(x\) if and only if an accepted output certificate \(w\) exists with \(U(w)=y\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.certificate_output
  (M : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Machine) (x y : ℕ) :
  y ∈ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute M x ↔
    ∃ w,
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Certificate M x w ∧
        Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract w = y
